findings.summary: The Bengali worked-example title used দিক, which means direction, instead of the established term for a triangle side.
evidence: The title একটি দিক খুঁজুন did not match the section's use of বাহু for a geometric side.
findings.resolution: Changed the title to একটি বাহু নির্ণয় করুন.

findings.summary: The Bengali worked example used abbreviated and inconsistent side labels instead of the established terminology.
evidence: The example used বিপরীত and সংলগ্ন while the trigonometry explanation used বিপরীত বাহু and সন্নিহিত বাহু.
findings.resolution: Aligned both example formulas with বিপরীত বাহু and সন্নিহিত বাহু.
